title: Prove sharp 9h/8 error for a rounded half-shear (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp error **9h/8** for one internally rounded positive half-shear between two distinct normalized real Walsh axes, for every directed pair of four coordinates. Claim type: scoped written proof with an exact finite certificate. This answers a nonintegral part of JosieElliston #6140's question beyond CubeJerry #6146's exact integer-shear domain.

```text
y = R_h(Ax)
z = R_h((I + E_ts/2)y)
F(x) = R_h(Bz)
comparator = B(I + E_ts/2)Ax
sharp maximum error = 9h/8, for every t != s
```

The parity proof improves the direct 11h/8 triangle estimate and gives twelve attaining inputs. The complete error has period 16h in each input coordinate; an explicit counterexample rules out period 8h. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit JosieElliston #6140 for the intervening-shear question and CubeJerry #6146 for the integer-shear model and parity context. Nick Petalas #6129's pure-stage result is background, not the new proof step. The retained deferred-row, shear-equivariance and native lineage is credited in the README. No predecessor scientific code or census is replayed.

## Evidence

- Before: #6146 explicitly excludes nonintegral shears; rounding the half-shear introduces another rounding site, and its integer-shear period does not apply.
- After: a self-contained universal parity bound, explicit attaining inputs for all twelve orientations, and two separately implemented complete residue censuses. Each checks 786,432 pair/input cases and hashes all 3,145,728 eighth-unit error coordinates. Their hashes and all per-orientation histograms agree. Another 3,072 complete-vector Fraction comparisons, seven semantic controls, eight rejected inputs, 515 signed half-rounds and 576 signed/large translations pass.

From the repository root, use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/rounded-half-shear-walsh/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/rounded-half-shear-walsh/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/rounded-half-shear-walsh/independent.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rounded-half-shear-walsh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rounded-half-shear-walsh --check-source-history
```

The direct commands report `PASS_ROUNDED_HALF_SHEAR_WALSH` and `PASS_INDEPENDENT_HALF_SHEAR_WALSH`. All three registered commands passed locally, timed individually at 0.884, 0.890 and 5.985 seconds. These are verification durations, not performance claims. Registered metadata/pins, exact committed bytes/source ancestry, source compilation/AST bounds, official export integrity and read-only Git-free optimized replays passed. No registered local obligation is deferred to CI. The primary emits a generated receipt bound to all eight package files and the context input.

## Limitations

One positive half-shear, two real axes, nearest-even rounding, exact pre-round arithmetic and sufficient range. Other coefficients, complex gates, extra stages, physical coefficient service, finite-width range, reversible history and actual compiler/caller binding remain open. This is not a native supplier, precision saving, framework-assumption discharge or complete multiplication theorem. All five selected assumptions remain. Lean, Docker, the selected scientific cold replay, independent human review and formal-kernel acceptance are unrun or unclaimed.

Only eight new files under `research/rounded-half-shear-walsh/` change. Canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8, selected #7000 unchanged. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19572871).

## Open next questions

Determine a sharp law for another rational shear coefficient after proving its valid even-translation period. Separately, bind this exact tile to one emitted `precision_tape` trace and price coefficient service, range, reversal, storage and the complete caller before changing precision. Neither follow-up is reserved here.

## Related open work

- #7468 concerns integral prefixes of the complex native C tensor. Its endpoint-integrality question differs from this real rounded half-shear error; no competing number is computed.
- #7411 prices a local Walsh packing change for a Type B idle. This result supplies no physical Walsh conversion tariff or packing improvement.
- #7413 prices shared Walsh basis assignments at that Type B stage. This result supplies only a rounding-interface constant, with no claimed conversion or scheduling gain.

- #7471 proves output-lattice hulls for rational rounded-linear programs under half-up rounding. This result computes a sharp nearest-even error and period for a particular Walsh/half-shear word; no competing error value is computed there.

The completion refresh inspected this account's seven other open PRs created since the CLAIM: #7469, #7470, #7471, #7472, #7473, #7476 and #7477. Only #7471 studies a related rounded-program boundary, as distinguished above. None computes a competing sharp error for this literal half-shear. No extra mathematical computation was run to compare their results.
